Observations below LOD in qc-passed samples

Count

## Pleural
qc |>
    filter(sample=="pleural")|>
    ggplot(aes(y = reorder(assay, n.belowlod), x = n.belowlod)) +
    geom_col() +
    labs(y = "Protein") 

## Plasma
qc |>
    filter(sample=="plasma")|>
    ggplot(aes(y = reorder(assay, n.belowlod), x = n.belowlod)) +
    geom_col() +
    labs(y = "Protein")

    labs(y = "Protein")
